LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: PARAGRAPH WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility (2 Sessions) • Handwriting •
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you improve your writing skills in Arabic?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text
2. write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: PARAGRAPH WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing for Grade 8 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you improve your writing skills in Arabic?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme from a given text
2. write a simple paragraph on the theme for effective communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
